description: Show spans for a trace id scoped to one or more app keys. Fields identical on every span (service, environment and other resource attributes) come once under shared; empty fields are left out.

appKeys.description: Application key or comma-separated/list of application keys.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

name: securenow_traces_show
title: Show Trace
